title: header field: newtype wrapper cleaner than deserialize_with
description: In crate-jmap-mail-types/src/query.rs lines 110-115, the header field uses #[serde(deserialize_with = "deserialize_header")] to enforce the 1-2 element constraint. A cleaner Rust pattern would be a validated newtype: pub struct HeaderFilter(Vec<String>) with TryFrom<Vec<String>> that enforces the constraint, converting it from a runtime deserialization check to a type-level invariant. This would: (1) make it impossible to construct an invalid HeaderFilter in Rust code (not just during deserialization), (2) eliminate the need for a special deserialize_with function, (3) give the constraint a named type that can appear in docs. The deserialize_with approach is common and not wrong, but it leaves the constraint invisible in the type signature — a Vec<String> could be 0 or 3 elements at the Rust level. Priority: moderate, since this is a public API design choice.
